name: Omyaru
subtitle: Omyaru Browser for iPhone and iPad
description: Omyaru Browser for iOS (AltStore Classic) — synchronized with Android Omyaru Browser releases.

apps.name: Omyaru Browser
apps.subtitle: Privacy browser and bookshelf
apps.localizedDescription: Omyaru Browser for iOS with full Android v0.15.18 feature parity: profiles (18 icons & custom colors), tab groups, private tabs, top/bottom address bar, Liquid Glass UI, scroll auto-hide toolbar, Page Tools (zoom 50%~200%, find in page, per-site shield exception, desktop/mobile UA), tab overview (1~10 columns, 1:1/3:4/16:9 aspect ratio, bottom-first order, duplicate after source, drag auto-scroll, undo close), hierarchical bookmarks & date-grouped history, download confirmation to Bookshelf, built-in image preloader, tracker/ad blocker, userscripts (.user.js), incremental scroll-stitch region capture, dual-mode watermark remover (offline inpainting + web auto-inject), hierarchical folder tree bookshelf (multi-column, batch move/delete, storage manager, PDF export), Face ID/PIN/Password app lock with app-switcher black shield, DoH encrypted DNS & WireGuard profile manager, and full Google Drive / AES-256-GCM encrypted sync (tabs, bookmarks, history, chunked bookshelf images, sync tab reset).

versions.localizedDescription: v0.15.18 (build 81): High-speed parallel Google Drive sync (multi-core off-MainActor PBKDF2, 6x concurrent chunk & batch transfers, single appDataFolder listing, persistent KeyRing cache, delta-only CRDT shelf replica), shared sync folder picker with per-account subfolder (<Folder>/<account>) & kernel flock cross-app sync lock for zero duplication with Umtomi, and automatic LiveContainer Live Activity fallback (live-updating progress notification + floating top sync pill).
